notablePrerequisites:
Sphinx of the Revelation does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}{E}.
You control a mana-producing permanent that can tap to produce at least {W} and a mana-producing permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
description:
Activate Sphinx of the Revelation by paying {W}{U}{U}, tapping it and paying at least {E}{E}{E}{E}, causing you to draw at least four cards.
Queza triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve the first Queza trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Sphinx of the Revelation triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Queza trigger.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sphinx of the Revelation.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent that can produce at least {W} or {U}.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W} or {U}.
Repeat from step 7 until you have {W}{U}{U} available.
Repeat from step 1.
You may pay additional {E} if able to net near-infinite card draw.
